verdicts.reason: A keeps the brand, headline and hero shoe at a readable size, but the shoe has slipped off its lime circle so they no longer read as one unit. The NEW VIDEO badge and the logo sit side by side, competing at the top, and the 'marathons' line is an awkward wrap. The top is crowded while the lower left is empty. B shrinks the shoe to a tiny afterthought in the bottom edge. The logo is an illegible speck, NEW VIDEO overlaps the circle edge, and the empty lime circle now dominates, so the brand and product are effectively lost.
